# Padmashri Agro Engineering Works — AI Context File
# https://www.padmashriagro.com/

## About
Padmashri Agro Engineering Works is a leading manufacturer and direct seller of agricultural implements based in Sadatpur, Sangamner, Maharashtra, India. Established in 1998, the company specializes in:

- Hydraulic Reversible Mouldboard Ploughs (MB Plough)
- Mechanical Reversible Ploughs
- Fixed Mouldboard Ploughs (Single-Sided)
- Tractor Cultivators (9-tine and 11-tine)
- Duckfoot / Sweep Cultivators
- Sugarcane Ridgers & Inter-row Cultivators
- Tractor Ridger / Bund Maker / 3-Row Furrowers
- Automatic Seed-cum-Fertilizer Drill Machines
- Heavy Duty Land Levelers / Scraper Blades
- Tractor Hydraulic Tipping Trailers (3T, 5T, 7T)
